card: P1 controls that can fail — walk four-state, refuse-missing-county, readable gate, 0005 split

snapshot.head: 7f41f52328ec40da0480d5eb65aad09ca3d4c3f9
snapshot.draft0005: origin/seat/property-ctx-walk-alias-schema:migrations/0005_ctx_alias_setback_easement.sql (read by ref; not applied; not copied as-is)

missionPremise: Four Factory controls exist and cannot fire. Nothing downstream of P1 is verifiable until each fails a known violation and passes a known-good. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-30_p1-factory_dispatch.md; OPS-19 F-08; A7/A9 and the 0005 split in _inbox/2026-08-30_ctx_execute_waves_WDLL.md.
completionPredicate: Hand back an uncommitted Factory diff plus this card's CP1/CP2/close. Each of the four controls is shown failing a named violation and passing a named good. No commit, push, deploy, migration apply, job start, bake, or publish.
scopeBasis: hauska-factory only, this worktree only. 0005 as drafted is not applied. landing-import is not re-run. alias-persist is not started against a live store. Gate 8 / P2-JURIS / ctx-publish trees are not opened. Routing pin `held` is plan-row values and is not treated as a rail lookup.

adversarial.claim: hasKeyPath treating null as present is the walk contract
adversarial.finding: test/publish.test.mjs 'a present key holding an explicit absence counts as present' asserts gradeParcelResponse pass on fullTier1Body with zoning:null, envelope:null, and baseFacts.landUse:null. That converted the defect into a specification. Mechanism: REQUIRED_TIER1_FACET_PATHS filtered through hasKeyPath, whose docstring says the value may be null.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: the six counties passed because land use is honestly absent; rejected because the card names CAD row and atom both carrying A1 on the same parcels

adversarial.finding: parseConformantFlags reads both forms but initialises county: BASTROP (48021). A missing or unparsed county is a silent Bastrop re-run. loadCountyLanding / countCountyLanding / loadCountyLandingPage also do county ?? BASTROP.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: only the spaced-form reader is the trap; rejected because the default fires even when the equals form is parsed as empty

adversarial.claim: refuseHeldCell or the routing pin is the collect gate
adversarial.finding: refuseHeldCell has four call sites (definition, hold-refuse-run proof job, two tests). The pin field is held, values [P-25, P-09, P-17 COVER, Factory 1 --apply], not holds keyed rail:<rail>. import_ledger is INSERT-only. Dockerfile copies only src and migrations, so an _inbox/ file is unreadable in the job image.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: extend the pin to rails; rejected as a schema change on a file no image contains

adversarial.claim: 0005 exists on origin/main and can be edited in place
adversarial.finding: origin/main 7f41f52 has migrations 0001–0004 only. The drafted 0005 lives on origin/seat/property-ctx-walk-alias-schema. It seeds five setback kind=absence rows (Austin, Kyle, Georgetown, Round Rock, Waco) plus four easement county-absence rows, and creates landing_cad_txgio_alias on whatever applyMigrations reaches (FACTORY_DATABASE_URL).
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: copy 0005 onto main and comment the seeds; rejected because the card requires a split and a probed_at CHECK, and because Factory migrate cannot be the bake-store writer

item1_fourState.what: Replace presence with four-state classification of every required leaf: value | absent-verified | not-applicable | refused. null is none of those.
item1_fourState.absentVerified: earned only with scope (or scopeSearched), evaluation-time asOf (refuses asOf === requestClock), and a nonempty basis. Walk-level check: two absent-verified leaves on the same path with identical basis fail.
item1_fourState.landUseAtom: meaning-shaped second input: baseFacts.landUse null while opts.landUseAtom is present fails BP-CONTENT-01. Gold 48021:34137 carries landUse value A1.
item1_fourState.bypasses: a fetchFn that never calls gradeTier1Content (none in src/jobs/verify-walk.mjs)

item2_refuseCounty.what: parseConformantFlags uses requireCountyFips(flagValue(argv, '--county')). No 48021 default. loadCounty* refuse a missing county. Close object carries runScope {job, county, apply, flood, replay} so the execution log names the resolved scope.
item2_refuseCounty.executes: parseConformantFlags, runConformant return, cli.mjs JSON close line
item2_refuseCounty.fails: COUNTY_REQUIRED / COUNTY_UNKNOWN thrown before any store write
item2_refuseCounty.bypasses: a caller that passes {flags:{county:'48021'}} explicitly (named, not defaulted)

item3_collectGate.what: src/control/collect-complete.mjs. SELECT latest import_ledger row for the rail's source table. Refuse COLLECT_INCOMPLETE when no row, counts disagree, or factory_count is 0. Band-1 (CAD) writer runConformant --apply calls it after Cloud-Run check and connect, before startRun. Home is the Factory store, not _inbox/.
item3_collectGate.notThePin: held is plan-row values; this gate does not read the pin
item3_collectGate.bypasses: dry-run / non-apply (no writer); a raw SQL writer that does not call runConformant

item4_0005split.0005a: migrations/0005a_landing_setback_easement.sql on Factory store. landing_setback_registry, landing_setback_record, landing_easement_gis. Drop every absence-kind seed (five setback absence + four easement county-absence; the drafted file's eight-row setback INSERT is the 'eight' the card named, of which five are absence). Keep sourced Bastrop/Elgin/Lockhart and the five GIS layers. probed_at + CHECK (kind <> 'absence' OR probed_at IS NOT NULL) on registry and record. source_url_verified_at timestamptz. applyMigrations regex widened to ^\d+[a-z]?_.*\.sql$ so 0005a is picked up; bake/ is not scanned.
item4_0005split.0005b: migrations/bake/0005b_landing_cad_txgio_alias.sql. landing_cad_txgio_alias only, CAD↔TxGIO identity, owners_agree IS TRUE, open-era unique. Planner applies this to STAGING_/PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL. Factory applyMigrations never sees it. requireAliasLandingTable SELECTs information_schema.tables and refuses ALIAS_TABLE_MISSING so alias-persist --apply fails loudly without 0005b.
item4_0005split.notDropped: 0005b is identity, not the P2-JURIS breadth table
item4_0005split.triggers: INSERT of an unprobed absence; alias persist apply against a store
item4_0005split.bypasses: applying 0005 as drafted (forbidden this card); Factory migrate applying 0005b (prevented by bake/ placement)

constraintsHonored: no commit, push, deploy, migration apply, job start, bake, publish, landing-import re-run
routing pin held not treated as rail keys
